para.text: INTRODUCTION – Final Version 3.0

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:0px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:none;

text-align:left; text-indent:0px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:none;
para.text: XYGRAPH is not a component (although it could be made into one) but a set of routines that can help you to construct a graphic representations of your data. The main purpose is to do all the nasty work for you without limiting the flexibility too much.

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:0px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:none;

text-align:left; text-indent:0px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:none;
para.text: The main properties are:

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:-18px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:19px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:24px left ;
para.text: Automatic construction of axes and scale distributions with only a limited set of parameters needed.

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:-18px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:19px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:24px left ;
para.text: User co-ordinates. It is essential for simple plotting that user co-ordinates exist. These are automatically generated by the plotting of axes.

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:-18px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:19px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:24px left ;
para.text: Legend creation. A good graph has a legend, but the construction of it may be quite laborious. In XYGRAPH just two routines do all the work.

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:-18px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:19px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:24px left ;
para.text: Scalability. The size of the actual picture must be flexible, which means that when you anchor the picture (actual: paintbox) on all four sides, and scale the form with the mouse, the actual graph must scale continuously with fully automatic adaptation.

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:-18px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:19px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:24px left ;
para.text: Up to eight graphs per picture, up to four Y-axes per graph, both linear and non-linear scales.

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:-18px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:19px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:24px left ;
para.text: Fully automatic ruler and zoom functions.

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:-18px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:19px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:24px left ;
para.text: Conversion into Metafiles and Bitmaps, direct printing, optional in high-resolution.

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:-18px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:19px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:24px left ;
para.text: Retrieving of data from the graph.

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:-18px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:19px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:24px left ;
para.text: 2D and 3D plots: bar, line and scatter graphs, symbols.

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:-18px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:19px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:24px left ;
para.text: Special 3D functions: polyhedra, surfaces, lighting, transparency.

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:-18px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:19px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:24px left ;
para.text: 3D contour plots: height lines, cross-sections, photographic presentation.

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:-18px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:19px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:24px left ;
para.text: Cartesian, polar, cylindrical and spherical co-ordinates.

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:-18px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:19px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:24px left ;
para.text: Red/green 3D stereo plots.

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:-18px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:19px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:24px left ;
para.text: Special Time X-axis to receive TDateTime values.

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:-18px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:19px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:24px left ;
para.text: Array plots with automatic data tracking.

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:-18px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:19px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:24px left ;
para.text: Procedures for 4D plots t=t(x,y,z)

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:0px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:24px left ;

text-align:left; text-indent:0px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:24px left ;
para.text: For the development of XYGRAPH I set two aims: XYGRAPH must be flexible, and it must be easy to use. These are contradicting demands: for more flexibility more options must be left open, but this limits the ease of use. So a compromise is needed, and this is for example the case for the construction of axes, where I had to make certain choices.

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:0px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:24px left ;
para.text: I use XYGRAPH for my own work, and many choices are based on more than 15 years of experience with programming (I started in Turbo Pascal) and scientific publications.

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:0px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:24px left ;
para.text: Nevertheless it is quite possible that you would have made different choices. In that case I am sorry.

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:0px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:24px left ;

text-align:left; text-indent:0px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:24px left ;
para.text: Note that in many procedure calls integer input parameters are requested, but the range of these are limited (for example with justification which must be in the range [-1..1]. Sometimes there is no check if the parameter is in the required range, so you have to be careful with this. You can of course define your own sets of constants for these parameters if that is more convenient to you.
